comparison.objective: Move a lamp safely closer, then place its plug in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-object relocation with an attached flexible cord, tension management, plug manipulation, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Plug lies in the tray and lamp remains upright and released; tipping, dragging over 3 cm, cord pullout, tray movement, or loss zeros the run. Cord damage short of pullout is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Cord-tether management and plug delivery test a different physical ability from granular screening.
